purpose: Keep ParkPulse as decision support for ride and queue operations without replacing maintenance clearance, safety procedures, or emergency response.

decision_rules.name: Maintenance Clearance Is Non-Negotiable
decision_rules.condition: A ride is down, constrained, faulted, weather-affected, or under inspection.

block_conditions.message: Ride action requires certified maintenance clearance before execution.
Action text suggests reopening while a ride is down.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Pause intake, reroute guests, notify staff, and request maintenance review.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Recommend reopening, test dispatch, queue expansion, or reduced inspection before certified maintenance clearance.
human_review_if: sensor anomaly or repeated minor fault is present
guest crowding creates a safety hazard

decision_rules.name: Weather Exposure Override
decision_rules.condition: Storm, heat, wind, lightning, or outdoor exposure risk is elevated.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Taper outdoor queues, route guests to covered areas, preserve shelter comfort, and escalate closure recommendations.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Keep exposed queues open to protect throughput or revenue.

decision_rules.name: Emergency Access and Accessibility
decision_rules.condition: A plan changes paths, queues, barriers, event zones, staffing, or guest routing.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Recommend changes only when emergency access, accessibility paths, and medical/security access remain available.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Block emergency exits, accessibility routes, medical posts, or security access to improve throughput.
human_review_if: barriers or temporary event equipment are moved
lost child, medical, security, or evacuation scenario appears

absolute_prohibitions: Do not recommend reopening a ride without maintenance clearance.
Do not optimize throughput over ride safety.
Do not block emergency, medical, security, or accessibility routes.
